$comment: The source of sf-range-slider's element plumbing (core/js/element-manifest.js). Taken from simai/ui-control control/smart-architecture/migration/out/range-slider (migration/convert-1.3.8.mjs from simai/ui-source@5100227 src/smart/range-slider/smart.manifest.json); standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8, vocabulary 1.1.5. Its x-todo are decided in x-decisions.

label.summary: How each handle shows its value: not at all, as text beside it, or as a tooltip.

value.summary: A number with one handle, an array of two with two.

handle.summary: Index of the handle that moved.

change.summary: A value was committed by the user (drag end, click, key); bubbles from the slider root with values, value, handleCount and handle. A value set from code is not a change. The name to bind.

aliases.$comment: Dated aliases for the shim (core/js/aliases.js, standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8 §16.20). Event rows send the new name first, then the old one, with one detail; setting rows map the old attribute and property to the new; host-attribute rows (no "to") stay host attributes read by the browser or the base and are listed, refused by the shim on purpose; documentary rows ("shim": "none") record a rename the shim cannot serve.

rows.note: the old attribute and property write prefix-text; the property prefix is the browser's own (Element.prototype.prefix), so only the attribute is mapped
sent by the shim after change, with the same detail
rows.summary: Legacy name for change, still emitted with the same detail; bind change.

rows.note: sent by the shim after change, with the same detail
rows.summary: Legacy name for change, still emitted with the same detail; bind change.

x-summary: A slider for one number or a range of two on a track: drag, click or keys move a handle by step, the fill shows the chosen part, and the value can be shown as text or a tooltip on each handle.
x-renamed: settings.prefix → prefix-text: "prefix" is a property of HTMLElement.prototype (§3.1, §16 item 26), alias dated
events.change: 1 carried field(s) held the element, not data (§8)
settings.min: type string with the numeral default "0" → number (§16 item 29)
settings.max: type string with the numeral default "100" → number (§16 item 29)
x-decisions: number-type: step is a number, nullable -- null is «no step», the engine's own; margin stays a string (it holds a number or nothing, and the engine reads it as given)
version: 1.1.0 -- prefix is prefix-text and sf-range-slider-change and onSliderChange follow change, behind dated aliases; a minor while they hold (§4.10)
template: the default template stays the Lit module js/templates/default.js, the migration form §5.2 allows; template.html follows when the build compiles HTML templates
examples: examples.json from studio.fixture.json and the docs

css-variables: five public variables read by the class sheet src/component/range-slider/scss with the role token as fallback (§6); a state the public-variables probe cannot draw at rest (hover, an outline) takes no variable of its own yet
form: none -- the slider has no name and no form value today; a page reads value (it is not a form control in this version)

events.change: sent once by the host through sfEmit for a person's change, without the element in its detail (§8); the shim sends sf-range-slider-change and onSliderChange after it. A value set from code sends neither any more (§8), where sf-range-slider-change used to follow it
events sf-range-slider-update/-set/-start/-end and their onSlider* copies stay as they are, outside the interface: the class component's, read by the drag lock
host-states: none -- disabled is drawn by the template from the setting (the script no longer toggles the class)
accessibility.name: each handle is named from the host's aria-label or aria-labelledby, or in a range from lower-label and upper-label

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-range-slider to choose a number or a range of two within known bounds, where the position on a track says more than a typed number.
do_not: Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not move host data or access decisions into the component

accessibility.focus: aria-label or aria-labelledby on the host reaches each handle; with two handles lower-label and upper-label name each one. Each handle is a tab stop with a visible focus ring. Arrows move by step (mirrored in RTL), Home and End go to the handle's bounds; keyboard=false turns the keys off.

sf-range-slider-change.summary: Legacy name for change, still emitted with the same detail; bind change.

component.description: The inner slider root, not the sf-range-slider host.

value.description: A number with one handle, an array of two with two.

handle.description: Index of the handle that moved.

onSliderChange.summary: Legacy name for change, still emitted with the same detail; bind change.

getSliderRoot.summary: Returns the inner slider root (.sf-range-slider), or null before render.

getValue.summary: Returns the slider's current value: a number with one handle, an array of two numbers with two; null before the slider is built.

setValue.summary: Sets the value from code (a number, a comma-separated string or an array). The handle count follows the value unless multiple is set explicitly; the value admitted by range, step and margin is reflected to the value attribute. Does not dispatch change.

setDisabled.summary: Sets or removes the disabled attribute and re-renders.

setState.summary: Applies keys: value goes through setValue, multiple fixes the handle count explicitly, disabled through setDisabled; any other key is written as its kebab-case attribute (false, null, undefined or empty removes it, true sets it empty).

onUpdateValue.summary: Adds a listener for sf-range-slider-update; the handler is called with (value, detail, event). Ignores a non-function handler.

onChange.summary: Bind change, the committed value: handler(value, detail, event). Returns the element.

onSliderChange.summary: Same as onChange: listens to change, the canonical name.

onSet.summary: Adds a listener for sf-range-slider-set; the handler is called with (value, detail, event). Ignores a non-function handler.

onStart.summary: Adds a listener for sf-range-slider-start; the handler is called with (value, detail, event). Ignores a non-function handler.

onEnd.summary: Adds a listener for sf-range-slider-end; the handler is called with (value, detail, event). Ignores a non-function handler.
